high_level_description: This image is of an Indian postage stamp commemorating Dr. Radhakrishnan, who served as the President of India from 1962 to 1967. The stamp was released on the 75th birth anniversary of Dr. Radhakrishnan, which took place on September 5, 1967. Subject: The central figure on the stamp is Dr. Radhakrishnan, depicted in a formal portrait. He is wearing traditional Indian attire, including a turban and glasses, which reflect his scholarly background and cultural heritage. **Text
